messages:
maria: Postmortem follow-up: runtime cache-eviction incident. Using this thread to lock owners for runbook/playbook edits and follow-up automation. TL;DR: we saw recurring evictions under high small-batch traffic — need clearer triage steps, safe commands, and an escalation path to SRE oncall.

ajay: Thanks — postmortem here: https://redwood.inc/postmortems/cache-evict-2026 (summary attached). Main gap: triage commands + safe fallback routing. Proposing action items below.

sophie: I can take runbook edits for the triage checklist + commands. ETA end of next sprint (2026-04-02).

kevin: I can own the restart/automation side (ensure config changes are safe + scripted restart).

james: I'll update the escalation section to include Dedicated on-call, infra lead, and product SRE contacts.

oncall-bot: Incident tag: *cache-eviction-pattern* — add recurrence detector. Recommended quick-check: `ri-check cache-stats --last 1h`.

maria: Concrete checklist proposal (paste this into runbook):
- run `ri-check cache-stats --last 1h` and note top hot keys
- `curl -s https://console.redwood/metrics | jq .cache.evictions`
- if evictions > 1000/min for 5m -> increase shard count: `ri-cli config set cache.shard_count 32`
- if latency > 200ms and evictions high -> route to fallback: `ri-route set model=redwood-small-quantized --reason='eviction-surge'`
- safe rollback command if change breaks: ```
ri-deploy rollback --to-tag stable-2026-03-12
```
Include expected outputs for each command and a short 'what to look for' note.

ajay: Good. Sophie, please add the commands exactly and include expected outputs/indicators. Kevin, confirm `ri-cli config set` safety and whether restart is required.

kevin: Confirmed: the config change is non-destructive but requires runtime restart to take effect. I'll add a pre-check and dry-run sequence and own restart automation. Suggest snippet:
```
ri-cli config check cache.shard_count
ri-cli config set --dry-run cache.shard_count=32
ri-cli config set cache.shard_count=32
ri-cli restart runtime --selector=cache-runtime=true
```
I'll also make a small helper script that wraps this with safety checks.

sophie: :thumbsup: I'll add checklist + sample outputs and a small 'how to interpret' section. Will open PR to runbooks repo.

maria: Owners & due dates (please ack):
- Runbook triage checklist: sophie - 2026-04-02
- Escalation path rewrite (include infra-lead fallback): james - 2026-03-30
- Restart automation + precheck script: kevin - 2026-04-09
- Recurrence detector + PD rule/dashboard: ajay - 2026-04-06
Ping me if you need to shift dates.

james: Quick Q: add 'if oncall unreachable' fallback to email infra-lead@redwood.com and post to #infra? Also add exec notification template?

maria: Yes, add infra-lead fallback and include PG rotation steps and exec-notify template.

sophie: Will include infra-lead contact and a tiny text flowchart for triage -> escalate -> exec notify (with expected times).

ajay: I'll build the recurrence dashboard (weekly) and set an alert. Can we agree to re-evaluate in 2 weeks after changes?

kevin: One more useful grep for triage to add to runbook logs section:
```
kubectl -n runtime logs -l app=runtime | grep 'kv trim' | tail -n 200
```
That gives a quick view of runtime trimming activity.

maria: Good. Also include `ri-metrics export --from=1h --metric=cache.evictions` as a recommended export step for postmortem analysis.

sophie: I'll draft the PR with all above and a short blurb for the ops 'postmortem followups' doc so execs can see status.

maria: Final checklist before I close this thread: PRs for runbook + playbook + automation merged, recurrence dashboard alert in prod, and a one-pager in ops doc. I will ping once PRs are linked here. :pray:

kevin: Ack — I'll post the helper script link once the repo is ready.

ajay: Acked. I'll create the PD rule and add a weekly metric review to my calendar.

sophie: Acked, starting runbook PR now.

maria: Thanks team — will follow up with links. If anyone hits blockers tag me or post in #eng-sre.
